observations: This one --version invocation printed the expected version/build and exited 0 within 10 seconds.
No project-matching soffice process was active at either inventory snapshot; no process was terminated.
All 13 targeted configuration, registry and binary files exist; binary versions and main.xcd identify 26.8.0.3.
Five directly project-path-matching Application Error events identify soffice.bin and KERNELBASE.dll, exception code 0x00000000.
inference: The existing zero-exit/no-output conversion result is consistent with a native soffice.bin crash masked by a success-looking wrapper exit. File presence and successful --version do not establish Calc loading/calculation/saving or the author's macro route.
unknowns: The events were not independently correlated by PID and start/end time to each individual prior conversion command.
KERNELBASE.dll is the recorded faulting module; this does not identify the underlying trigger, missing installation state, dependency, profile, graphics or other runtime fault.
A proper Windows installation or Linux runtime has not been tested here, and neither is proven to resolve the fault.
interpretation: Treat current Calc/recalculation readiness as unverified. Any later installation or alternate-runtime route must repeat a positive calculation/cache control and a negative error control, then verify the unchanged author macro route. No conversion, installation or repair was attempted in this diagnosis.
